The book also already holds six positions, so no new thesis can be bought without an exit first. BTC-EUR (EUR 410.75) is 2.7% over the ~EUR 400 cap. That drift is within tolerance and does not justify a taxable EUR realisation, given the PFU and the full-portfolio PVCT snapshot it would trigger, and no other crypto is held to rebalance into. 4GLD.DE (120.02) is well above goldfinger's 106.50 break. PHAG.L (54.77) sits mid-range, and goldfinger wants no action there. ALV.DE and AIR.PA have no analyst saying their thesis is breaking. The SLB position (EUR 0.15) is dust: selling it would cost more in the EUR 1.25 floor fee than it raises, and it would use up a trade slot.
